notes.best_deployable: V8_capped_rul240_reg (oof saved in labels-targets_oof.csv, fixed threshold 0.6 / smoothing 3 / persistence 3)
notes.metric_best_but_shortcut: V1c_exclude_90_200 and V1_exclude_100_160: excluding the band removes ALL condition-1 negatives (cond-1 lives <=161 min); V1b (110-140) keeps 37 cond-1 negatives and its gain vanishes. Gains (misses 607->356) are concentrated on cond-1 bearings 1_1/1_3/1_4/1_5 => the classifier learns 'condition 1 => failing', a dataset prior that will not transfer to field machines.
notes.selection_bias: Band widths 110-140 and 90-200 and cap 240 were run after seeing V1/V4 pooled OOF results; ensembles E1/E2 chosen post hoc. Nested threshold = per-fold F1-max threshold on the other 14 bearings' OOF probs (pseudo-nested: those OOF probs come from models that trained on the held-out bearing).
notes.rul: Regressor unchanged in all variants (baseline OOF rul_pred reused; identical seeds/rows/features). rul_mae 30.85 everywhere. Inverting V4's capped-RUL output gave MAE 36.5 alone; 50/50 blend with baseline 30.31 (one a-priori weight, negligible).
